notes: Both 'How's belong to the single מֶה under rule 25's distributed interrogative reading; the second colon has no conjunction, so the distributed reading governs rather than rule 35 fusion.
'him that' and 'that hath' are rule 2's נָצְרוּ דָעַת / טוֹב־עַיִן pattern: supplied relative frames making a bare nominal into a relative clause, each one added unit.
